description: H52c-a synthetic twins (#52): the predictions H52c missed. Constructed before the H52c-a candidate; not independent labels. `findings` are every finding the candidate must report.

specs/001-demo/spec.md: - THEN the system MUST export drafts.

cases.note: Every 0.1.20 requirement was admitted by its ID alone (E1.4 missing); the modal step makes E1.4 partial.

specs/001-demo/spec.md: - WHEN a plan is checked, THEN the consumer MUST follow VPC-REQ-01.

findings: I2.3|specs/001-demo/tasks.md|3|Reference REQ-02 has no definition in the supplied specs.
cases.note: The step joins VPC to an ID, so VPC becomes the feature's own namespace (H9) and the task's VPC-REQ-02 is read locally and is undefined.
